title: Bank Details / How to Donate | Saylani Welfare
text: Saylani Welfare accepts donations (Zakat, Sadqa, Sadqa-e-Jariah, Fitra, Fidya, Kaffara, Qurbani/Aqiqah, and general welfare donations) via several channels: direct bank deposit/transfer to Saylani's listed bank accounts (viewable on the official 'Bank Details' page at saylaniwelfare.com/bank-details, which lists current account numbers for multiple Pakistani banks), online donation through the website's 'Donate Now' flow (card/online banking), and international wire transfer or donation portals for donors in the USA, UK, and Canada. After sending a donation by bank transfer, donors are asked to email details of the amount, date, bank used, and the intended purpose (e.g., Zakat, Sadqa, Qurbani) to info@saylaniwelfare.com or donation@saylaniwelfare.com so Saylani can issue a receipt and apply the funds correctly; if no purpose is specified within a few days, Saylani applies the donation where it judges the need to be greatest. SahulatAI does not have Saylani's exact bank account numbers on file - for the current, verified account numbers, IBANs, and swift codes, users should be directed to the official Bank Details page or asked to contact Saylani directly.
